Class CallbackRegistrations

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.oidc.CallbackRegistrations
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.registration.ClientRegistration>, org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.registration.ClientRegistrationRepository
public final class CallbackRegistrations extends Object implements org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.registration.ClientRegistrationRepository, Iterable<org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.registration.ClientRegistration>
The application's registrations, each one who signs in with sending the provider back to who's callback: <root>/oidc/callback/{registrationId}. Such a registration left at Spring Security's default redirect URI ("{baseUrl}/{action}/oauth2/code/{registrationId}", which CommonOAuth2Provider and an issuer-uri registration get) is pointed at who's callback; any other is used as written, and problem(ClientRegistration, WhoPaths) says when who cannot serve it.
